purpose: Define a future casefile for consented testimony before any such testimony enters DeathVocab.

top_level_fields.note: DV-TST-######; not the same as DV-REC.
role, relationship to death, broad context, and safety flags without names by default.
date band, interviewer, mode, whether recorded, and whether pre-interview occurred.
clinical, legal, cultural, child, suicide, custody, institutional, employer, family-conflict, and identification flags.
where raw audio/transcript lives; never inside public zip unless explicitly safe and public.
candidate scene atoms; may produce zero records.
exact language candidates; all blocked until quote gate and contributor release pass.
what must be removed, generalized, or held.
editorial, ethics, clinical/tone, cultural/tradition, high-gate, or legal-adjacent review as relevant.
records produced, if any; initially empty.
records/surfaces affected by withdrawal or amendment.

admission_requirements_for_any_testimony: consent state at or above approved_for_internal_archive_only
contributor review complete or explicitly waived with safe reason
forbidden_fields_in_public_records: raw legal name unless explicitly approved
exact institution names unless public and reviewed
